raw_site_text: Almost half of the firms are located in the Cundinamarca region that includes the capital city, Bogota, with another quarter in the two regions around Cali and Medellin
justification: Firms concentrated in the Cundinamarca/Bogota region and regions around Cali and Medellin.
note: About one quarter of firms elsewhere are not identified; Cali and Medellin rolled up to Valle Del Cauca and Antioquia.
